policy: This registry contains only generic research hypotheses that must be tested independently with public data. No private source material, internal code, desk P&L, screenshots, paths, execution conventions, or proprietary thresholds are stored here.

hypotheses.title: Forecast vintage quality matters more than final historical labels
hypotheses.question: Do point-in-time load, wind and solar forecast revisions explain subsequent Belgian system imbalance better than final historical forecast labels?
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Only test ex-ante after feature availability is certified at the relevant commercial gate.

hypotheses.title: Intra-hour residual-load shape contains quarter-hour information
hypotheses.question: Within an hour, does the deviation of quarter-hour residual load from the hourly mean explain the relative shape of Belgian quarter-hour prices and/or subsequent imbalance economics?
hypotheses.formula: residual_load = load_forecast - solar_forecast - wind_forecast; spread_qh = residual_load_qh - mean_hour(residual_load)
time_controls: DA QH price source must be public and timestamped
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Evaluate long and short legs separately with walk-forward and post-regime holdout.

hypotheses.title: Quarter-hourly market design changes the useful signal set
hypotheses.question: Did the introduction of quarter-hourly day-ahead pricing materially change the stability of hourly versus quarter-hourly relationships?
time_controls: use the officially verified first business delivery date
exact intraday UTC transition is not inferred when the official source does not provide it
never pool pre/post without separate estimates
hypotheses.promotion_rule: All discovery results must report pre/post performance separately.

hypotheses.title: Recent directional consistency is more informative than a simple mean
hypotheses.question: For lagged historical imbalance or spread features, does sign consistency times magnitude outperform a simple rolling mean as a regime indicator?
hypotheses.formula: directionality = abs(sum(x))/sum(abs(x)); intensity = abs(mean(x)); score = directionality * intensity
time_controls: exclude current delivery day and unavailable recent settlements
hypotheses.promotion_rule: No fixed threshold may be promoted without walk-forward stability and multiplicity control.

hypotheses.title: Cross-border tightness amplifies local imbalance severity conditionally
hypotheses.question: Conditional on Belgian system direction, do low import/export capability, RAM/CNEC tightness or saturated borders amplify imbalance-price severity?
time_controls: historical ATC/JAO knowledge timing must be certified for ex-ante use
ex-post mechanism analysis may proceed earlier
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Treat capacity as a conditional amplifier, not an unconditional direction signal.

hypotheses.title: Renewable forecast error is regime-dependent rather than a permanent directional rule
hypotheses.question: Are large positive solar/wind surprises associated with long-system or low-price outcomes only under specific load, season, hour and cross-border conditions?
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Reject any unconditional renewable-surprise rule that is unstable by regime.

hypotheses.title: Temperature conditions the load forecast error distribution
hypotheses.question: Does temperature deviation from a seasonal reference explain Belgian load error and, conditionally, system imbalance?
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Must demonstrate incremental value beyond load forecast itself.

hypotheses.title: Spatial cloud location matters more than country-average cloud cover
hypotheses.question: Can public high-resolution cloud/radiation data weighted by Belgian PV capacity geography improve intraday solar-error estimates?
hypotheses.promotion_rule: Validate MW-error reduction prospectively before using any trading interpretation.

hypotheses.title: Physical direction and trade economics are separate questions
hypotheses.question: Even when system direction is predictable, does the available DA/ID entry price leave enough spread versus subsequent imbalance to create a robust edge?
hypotheses.promotion_rule: A direction hit-rate alone can never qualify a rule as robust.
